main_text.p: שִׁלְכָה [?] f. Nomen portæ Hierosolymis, à Conjecta & accumulata terra, ad parandam viam regis, sic dicta, 1.Par.26.16. Jes.6.13. Confer 1.Reg.10.5.12. 2.Chron.9.11.

שָׁלַל Spoliavit, Prædatus, Deprædatus est: Præt. וְשָׁלַל שְׁלָלָה [?] Et spolier spolium ejus, Ezech.29.19. שָׁלוּ [?] Spoliasti; Habac.2.v.8. שֹׁל תְּשֻׁלּוּ־לִי [?] Spoliando spoliabitis ipsi, id est, Relinquetis ipsi spolium, spicas scilicet quas colligat; Ruth.2.17. Niph.Fut. יִשָּׁל [?] vide in נָשַׁל. Hithp.Præt. הִשְׁתּוֹלְלוּ In prædam dederunt se, Psal.76. v.6. pro הש [?] ex usu Chaldaico: Simile vide in חבר in Hithpahel. Partic. מִשְׁתּוֹלֵל Prædæ exponit se, Jesa.59.15. R.Sal. Aberrans, Vesanus, Stultus habetur, & sic quoq; præcedentem locum Psalmi explicat.

שׁוֹלָל m. Spoliatus, Mich.1.8. R.Salomon, Aberrans, Vesanus, Insanum agens, quasi מְטוּרָף מְדֻעָתוֹ [?] Raptus & spoliatus mente suâ, ut Ab. Esra scribit: Sic הַמּוֹלִיךְ יוֹעֲצִים שׁוֹלָל [?] Qui facit ut consiliariorum quisque Amens, Demens fiat, Job.12.17.19.
שָׁלָל m.: Præda, Spolium, Gen.49.27. Constr. אֶת־שְׁלַל אֹיְבֶיךָ [?] Prædam inimicorum tuorum, Deut.20.14. Aff. כָּל־שְׁלָלָהּ [?] Omnem prædam ejus, Ibid.

שָׁלַם Compleri, Perfici: Pacem habere vel colere, Pace, Prosperitate frui, Pacem precari, id est, Salutare. Præter. וְשָׁלְמוּ Et completi erunt dies luctus tui, Jes.60.20. Part. præsens, שֹׁלְמִי Pacem colenti mecum, Psal.7.5. Infin. לְשָׁלוֹם Ad salutandum, 2.Regum 10.13. Imp. וּשְׁלַם Et pacem habeto, Job.22.21. Chald. Partic. Pehil. וְלָא שְׁלִים Necdum est perfecta sive absoluta, Esræ 5. v.16. Pih. שִׁלֵּם Perficere, Complere, 1.Reg.9.25. Job.8.6. Item, Solvere, Persolvere, Reddere, Rependere, Retribuere, Compensare: Præt. וּשְׁלַם אִתּוֹ Et

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation and several Hebrew forms are uncertain in the scan and are marked [?]. The Hebrew lemmas and inline forms were read from a low-resolution image. "Jes." is printed as "Jef." with a long s and is given as Jes. Running head is Hebrew and may be misread. The catchword "Et" sits at the lower right below the last line. Several spots of paper speckle and a small mark at the top left were ignored.
